target_customer: Clinicians and pharmacists, plus healthcare organizations licensing drug information
problem: Providers need fast, readable drug reference to prescribe, dispense and counsel, and existing tools are clunky or expensive.
business_model: Free consumer app plus organization licensing and partnerships

founders.name: Derek Borkowski
education: University of Minnesota, Doctor of Pharmacy (YC page; podcast says class of 2018)
founders.background_notes: YC page: pharmacist and software engineer with experience in community pharmacy, pharma industry and digital health; runs Cosmas Health, parent of Pyrls, per podcast listings.

competitors.name: Medscape Reference
competitors.what: Free drug lookup, dosing and interaction checker

technical_complexity.rationale: A content-driven web and mobile reference app built by a solo pharmacist-developer; the hard part is content curation, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbent references have deep content and brand; Pyrls competes on design and simplicity, which is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents remained; Pyrls signed an EQUIPP Copilot partnership with Pharmacy Quality Solutions (an Innovaccer company) in December 2025.

market_need_then: Clinicians use drug reference many times a day; competitors listed in a 2010 comparison show a long-standing paid and free market.

branding.domain_note: Uses pyrls.com (no vowels), no prefix or suffix.

identity.visual_style: Simple, clean app per store listing

branding.community_and_virality: Founder interviews on several pharmacy podcasts.

brand_strength.rationale: Niche awareness among pharmacists through podcasts; name is vowel-less and a podcast host even asked where it comes from.

outcome_analysis: Pyrls is a three-person, pharmacist-led reference app that grew to tens of thousands of clinicians (50,000+ per YC, 100,000+ in a 2025 partner release) on little capital. A pharmacist founder who also codes gave it founder-market fit and low costs. Its December 2025 partnership with Pharmacy Quality Solutions is the main milestone found. No priced round was verified and the company is still active.
notes: Unverified: VCBacked and BounceWatch list a $500K pre-seed on 2022-03-22 with Y Combinator; no primary source found. Competitor sources are a 2010 comparison (long before batch); no 2021-22 dated source found. User count conflicts: 50,000+ (YC) vs 100,000+ (partner boilerplate). pyrls.com site fetch returned only the name.
